note.en: A points threshold is set by the Dean; applicants scoring above it are conditionally accepted, and thresholds vary from year-to-year.

evidence.quote: For each programme, the Dean will set a points threshold. Applicants scoring above the points threshold will be conditionally accepted – the points thresholds can vary from year-to-year and programme-to-programme.
